seeded_failure.symptom: Azure CLI commands fail with error 'ResourceGroupNotFound: The Resource Group could not be found'.
seeded_failure.cause: The default resource group parameter in Azure CLI settings was pre-set to a non-existent resource group.
seeded_failure.fix: Clear or update the default CLI resource group using 'az configure --defaults group=<valid-resource-group>'.

seeded_failure.symptom: The developer user is able to delete the storage account inside the restricted resource group without receiving an authorization error.
seeded_failure.cause: The developer account was assigned Contributor role directly on the Subscription scope during account creation.
seeded_failure.fix: Remove the subscription-level Contributor role assignment using az role assignment delete or Azure Portal, leaving only the Reader role at the resource group scope.
